# ACLine

> A local SDLC tracker for coding agents. Specs, tasks, decisions, verification
> results, approvals and an append-only audit trail live in one SQLite file,
> driven by the acline CLI, an MCP server, and Claude Code hooks. A task
> completes only when the store holds the checks and approvals its risk
> requires — "the agent said it's done" is never the evidence.

Install: `curl -fsSL https://acline.nizaami.com/install.sh | bash`

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ows4444/cli-acline#readme): overview, install, quickstart, command reference
- [Architecture](https://github.com/ows4444/cli-acline/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): packages, data flow, authority model, hooks, MCP, orchestrator
- [Threat model](https://github.com/ows4444/cli-acline/blob/main/docs/THREAT_MODEL.md): what is protected, from whom, what is enforced and what is not
- [Changelog](https://github.com/ows4444/cli-acline/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): behavior changes
- [Security policy](https://github.com/ows4444/cli-acline/blob/main/SECURITY.md): reporting a vulnerability

## Related

- [VS Code extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ows4444.acline-ai): browse and act on the store from the editor
